summary:
AETHYRX JARVIS – Your Voice, Earth's Intelligence is an AI-powered Earth observation and environmental analysis platform designed to help users understand changes happening across our planet.

The project includes several features such as Mission Dashboard, Earth Explorer, Data Laboratory, Trend Detective, Anomaly Monitor, AI Assistant, and NASA Image Explorer. These features aim to help users explore Earth-related information, identify environmental trends, monitor unusual changes, and understand important observations through AI assistance.

The main objective of this project is to make Earth system information easier to explore, analyse, and understand. It focuses on using technology and artificial intelligence to support environmental awareness and data-driven decision-making.

Project Theme: Be an Earth System Trend Detective.

details:
AETHYRX JARVIS is an AI-powered Earth observation and environmental analysis web application developed under the theme "Be an Earth System Trend Detective."

The platform aims to make Earth-related information easier to explore, understand, and analyse. It includes interactive modules such as Mission Dashboard, Earth Explorer, Data Laboratory, Trend Detective, Anomaly Monitor, AI Assistant, NASA Image Explorer, and Reports & History.

These modules are designed to help users explore Earth-related information, understand environmental patterns, identify unusual changes, and gain insights through AI-assisted interactions.

Technology Used: Google AI Studio and Google Gemini AI. Gemini AI supports intelligent interactions and assists in the development of the application.

The creative aspect of this project is bringing multiple Earth exploration and analysis features together in one user-friendly platform. It connects artificial intelligence with Earth science to make environmental information more accessible and understandable.

The main objective is to encourage environmental awareness, support data-driven understanding, and demonstrate how AI technology can help people explore and understand our planet.

Our team focused on developing an informative, interactive, and user-friendly platform that combines technology, innovation, and environmental awareness.
